name: Accordion
description:
Sections that open in place. The chevron turns; items are set apart by space and hover
fills, never by dividers (R5.8). Use for secondary detail (advanced settings, raw data),
not for primary navigation.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The uncontrolled value of the item(s) that should be initially expanded.

To render a controlled accordion, use the `value` prop instead.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

props.name: hiddenUntilFound
props.description:
Allows the browser's built-in page search to find and expand the panel contents.

Overrides the `keepMounted` prop and uses `hidden="until-found"`
to hide the element without removing it from the DOM.

props.name: keepMounted
props.description:
Whether to keep the element in the DOM while the panel is closed.
This prop is ignored when `hiddenUntilFound` is used.

props.name: loopFocus
props.description:
Deprecated following the [APG guidance update](https://github.com/w3c/aria-practices/pull/3434)
to remove roving focus.

This prop no longer affects keyboard focus behavior.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Whether multiple items can be open at the same time.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Event handler called when an accordion item is expanded or collapsed.
Provides the new value as an argument.

props.name: orientation
props.description:
Deprecated following the [APG guidance update](https://github.com/w3c/aria-practices/pull/3434)
to remove roving focus.

This prop no longer affects keyboard focus behavior.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).

props.name: render
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: value
props.description:
The controlled value of the item(s) that should be expanded.

To render an uncontrolled accordion, use the `defaultValue` prop instead.

slots.name: Item
slots.signature: ({ title, icon, meta, level, className, children, ...rest }: AccordionItemProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon after the chevron. Pass it without a size.

props.name: level
props.description: Heading level of the trigger, to fit the page outline.

props.name: meta
props.description: Trailing data: a count, a status, a short value.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading or title content.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Event handler called when the panel is opened or closed.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).

props.name: render
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: value
props.description:
A unique value that identifies this accordion item.
If no value is provided, a unique ID will be generated automatically.
Use when controlling the accordion programmatically, or to set an initial
open state.
